  "function": "() => {
  const rows = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[class*="tableContentRow"]'));
  return rows.map((r, i) => {
    const text = r.innerText;
    const asinMatch = text.match(/ASIN\s*([A-Z0-9]+)/);
    const skuMatch = text.match(/SKU\s*([^\n\t]+)/);
    const links = Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('a')).map(a => ({ text: a.innerText.trim(), href: a.href }));
    const inputs = Array.from(r.querySelectorAll('input, kat-input')).map(inp => ({
      val: inp.value,
      placeholder: inp.getAttribute('placeholder')
    }));
    return {
      index: i,
      asin: asinMatch ? asinMatch[1] : null,
      sku: skuMatch ? skuMatch[1] : null,
      links,
      inputs
    };
  });
}",
  "pageId": 18,
  "waitForStableDom": false
}

  const panel = document.querySelector('[class*="actionPanelWrapper"]');

    tag: i.tagName,
    id: i.id,
    placeholder: i.getAttribute('placeholder') || i.placeholder,
    value: i.value,
    className: i.className,
    parentText: i.parentElement?.innerText?.slice(0, 50)
  }));
  
  const allDropdowns = Array.from(panel.querySelectorAll('kat-dropdown, select')).map(d => ({
    id: d.id,
    placeholder: d.getAttribute('placeholder'),
    value: d.value,
    options: d.getAttribute('options'),
    className: d.className
  }));
  
  const allButtons = Array.from(panel.querySelectorAll('kat-button, button, a')).map(b => ({
    tag: b.tagName,
    label: b.getAttribute('label'),
    text: b.innerText.trim(),
    variant: b.getAttribute('variant'),
    className: b.className
  })).filter(b => b.text || b.label);
  
  return {
    allInputs,
    allDropdowns,
    allButtons,
    panelTextSnippet: panel.innerText.slice(0, 800)
  };
}",
  "pageId": 18,

}
